name: Arc'teryx
why: The dead bird — Vancouver alpine engineering whose laminated construction set menswear's technical ceiling; Veilance translates it into minimalist tailoring, and gorpcore made the shell a city status object.
origin: Founded 1989 in North Vancouver as a climbing-harness maker; renamed for Archaeopteryx, the first bird — the fossil is the logo. Owns its ARC'One factory in Canada; Amer Sports-owned since 2019.
opview: “Evolution in Action” — the house motto, named after the first bird.

onething.n: restored from the earlier draft; link is site search — verify

notes.tech: the construction is the product — laminated seams, WaterTight zips, an owned Canadian factory
notes.synth: GORE-TEX handled better than anyone — the technical ceiling of this map
notes.craft: ARC'One in Canada plus spec-sheet disclosure; held from 5 by offshore volume production
notes.street: gorpcore's crown jewel — the shell in every city fit
notes.ski: A serious ski programme inside a broader alpine technical house. The mountain is central but not exclusive, which is the difference between a four and a five here.

cities: Own stores in most major metros · REI · resale cult everywhere · Veilance in luxury stores
